place_in_the_composite: Apulia is ONE of the four pre-unification states averaged into Alfani's 'Italy' top-10% series (Alfani 2023 Stone WP 74, Fig. 2.1a; the others: Sabaudian State - Alfani 2015 JEH; Florentine State - Alfani & Ammannati 2017; Republic of Venice - Alfani & Di Tullio 2019). It is the primary tabulated series for that state; the composite's own table remains in Alfani 2021 (JEL, closed).
reading_against_the_cached_summary: the VoxEU-derived cache reads 64% at ~1650 and 82% at 1810 for 'Europe'/Italy; Apulia's primary table reads 67.1 (1650, propertyless excluded) / 70.1 (included) rising to 72.8 / 78.4 by 1750 - consistent in direction and level with the summary's mid-points; the 1550 anchor (57.2) is tentative by the authors' own note
